mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, just take a moment and notice how far you’ve come. This journey to confidence isn’t about making some huge, dramatic leap—it’s really about the quieter, day-to-day work of changing the way you talk to yourself. Sure, the path isn’t always a straight line, and those old doubts might never vanish completely. But every single step—every honest conversation, every bit of self-kindness, every brave choice—makes that voice inside you, the one that says you’re enough, just a little bit louder. Here’s what really matters: Confidence grows in the small decisions you make every day, not in one big moment of triumph. Old wounds? They can heal, if you meet them with honesty, compassion, and a little patience. And remember, comparing yourself to others only steals your joy, while gratitude and being present can bring it right back. Community and being open? Those are the keys to lasting change. And your worth—it isn’t something you have to earn. It’s already yours, and nothing can take that away. You don’t have to wait for the world to shift before you start. Begin with the next thought, the next conversation, the next gentle act toward yourself. Let the truth that you are enough shape how you show up—at work, with friends, in your dreams. And when the doubts creep back in, as they sometimes do, just remember you’re not alone. There are others walking this same path, learning to quiet the lies and live from a place of grace. The world needs people who know they’re enough—not because they’re perfect, but because they’re real. So as you go forward, may you find the courage to believe in your own worth, to share it freely with others, and to trust that, even on the tough days, you’re already enough.
